title: Caste: The Origins of Our Discontents
author: Isabel Wilkerson
summary: Isabel Wilkerson argues that race in America is best understood as part of a caste system, and compares it with caste in India and Nazi Germany. She backs the case with historical accounts and personal stories.
readIf: you want a wide-ranging, emotionally direct argument about hierarchy in American society.
skipIf: you prefer strictly academic, narrowly focused history.
